FormName.valUnicode: 買掛詳細計算(SQL) 処理

SQL_STMT_U.val:
SELECT pf.supplier_id, ':3' AS billing_start_date, ':4' AS billing_end_date,
pf.slip_count, pf.payment_slip_count, pf.previous_balance,
pf.standard_purchase_amount, pf.standard_return_amount, pf.standard_discount_amount, pf.standard_taxamount,
pf.reduced_purchase_amount, pf.reduced_return_amount, pf.reduced_discount_amount, pf.reduced_tax_amount,
pf.tax_adjustment, pf.payment_amount, pf.current_balance FROM payables_file pf WHERE pf.supplier_id BETWEEN :1 AND :2 AND pf.year_month = ':4' AND ( COALESCE(pf.previous_balance, 0) <> 0 OR COALESCE(pf.standard_purchase_amount, 0) <> 0 OR COALESCE(pf.standard_return_amount, 0) <> 0 OR COALESCE(pf.standard_discount_amount, 0) <> 0 OR COALESCE(pf.standard_taxamount, 0) <> 0 OR COALESCE(pf.reduced_purchase_amount, 0) <> 0 OR COALESCE(pf.reduced_return_amount, 0) <> 0 OR COALESCE(pf.reduced_discount_amount, 0) <> 0 OR COALESCE(pf.reduced_tax_amount, 0) <> 0 OR COALESCE(pf.payment_amount, 0) <> 0 OR COALESCE(pf.current_balance, 0) <> 0 ) ORDER BY pf.supplier_id;
